description: shell-mcp provides sandboxed shell execution for Goose agents. Commands run inside the microVM — destructive operations only affect the disposable container, not the host.

shell_execute.description: Run a single bash command inside the sandbox workspace

shell_exec_background.description: Run a command in the background; returns PID

shell_read_file.description: Read a file from the workspace

shell_write_file.description: Write content to a workspace file

security.note: All commands execute inside an isolated microVM. If an agent runs rm -rf /, it only destroys the ephemeral container — the host machine and persistent volumes are unaffected.
